faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KVK Haveri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KVK Haveri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Research Fellow (on temporary basis).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KVK Haveri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. (Agri.); preference will be given to Ph.D. graduates.

faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense. The appointment is purely temporary and can be terminated at any time.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti on 17.11.2026 at 11.00 AM.
